title: 菊花賞の後に・静かなる宣言

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother… I… I…
choice_data_list: You caught up to Mihono Bourbon… and passed her.
You caught up to Mihono Bourbon… and passed her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister… I… I…
choice_data_list: You caught up to Mihono Bourbon… and passed her.
You caught up to Mihono Bourbon… and passed her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I… I did!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did it… I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Bourbon?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uh, uh… Um, I…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. You "caught up" to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Speaking truthfully, I do not understand why you choose those words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In a race, there is only victory or defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is no "catching up." Yet…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: High levels of frustration detected. To think that I would lose the Kikuka Sho—that I would not win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …That you would catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Can you hear that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What a race! Good job, Bourbon! Good job, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: As expected of this year's stars! I'm so excited to see them again next year!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-they're not just cheering for you… They're cheering for me too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but I only got this far because I was chasing after you…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Incorrect. The crowd has acknowledged you as a worthy champion of this year's Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And my analysis produces similar results. Therefore, I have just one thing to say…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will not lose to you…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My rival.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm your… rival?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice. Will you race against me again?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I… I…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I won't get complacent just because I won today! I'll keep getting faster… and win our next race too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's voice echoes loudly. Her daring declaration reaches the ears of not only those nearby, but everyone at the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think about what race she should run in next to help her talent as a stayer bloom even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, we'll prepare for the Nikkei Sho as a jumping-off point.
